invariants.rationale: Method always returns a new merged JsonValue object regardless of parent/template being null.

invariants.expression: template == null || parent == null || (result != parent && result != template)
invariants.rationale: If neither parent nor template is null, result is a newly constructed JsonValue, not parent or template.

invariants.expression: template == null ? result == parent : parent == null ? result == template : true
invariants.rationale: When either parent or template is null, result is set to the non-null argument; otherwise, a new JsonValue.
Returned merged element is detached (parent == null), per Javadoc.
Merged always represents an object type (created as such).
